name: omp-2-dsh
description: Out-of-tree DeepSeek Harness plugin suite (omp ports): tree-engine, compact-mode, vibe-mode, tool-read-write, advisor, channel-wechat, mode-ui, plus release/profile/doc tooling.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/tree-engine run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-compact-mode run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-vibe-mode run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-tool-read-write run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-advisor run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-channel-wechat run build && pnpm --filter @dsh-plugin/dsh-mode-ui run build
